entities.summary: Peter Svensson (b. 1974-10-18, Hakarp parish) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hakarp parish and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
